notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (Nintendo's 86th fiscal year, the first full year of Nintendo Switch 2). The main source is Nintendo's English 'Annual Report 2026', a translation of its Japanese Annual Securities Report under J-GAAP (the Japanese original prevails), plus the English convocation notice of the 86th AGM (June 2, 2026). Both are on nintendo.co.jp. LEADER: Shigeru Miyamoto is Representative Director and Executive Fellow; relation 'executive' (he was never CEO or chair). He holds 5,000 shares (the notice; the annual report's directors table shows 50 hundred shares). No percentage is disclosed; it is far below 0.01% of the about 1.15 billion shares outstanding, so pctEconomic is null. LARGEST HOLDERS: the three largest disclosed holders that are not trust-bank or custodian nominee accounts. BlackRock's 6.24% comes from a large-volume holding report as of October 31, 2023 that Nintendo quotes in a note to its major-shareholders table, saying it 'could not confirm the actual number of shares held as of March 31, 2026'; that ratio predates the March 2026 cancellation of treasury shares, and is stale. The MUFG and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust group reports quoted in the 2025 report are no longer quoted. The Bank of Kyoto (3.37%, down from 4.19%) and GIC Private Limited (2.10%, account 'C') are from the register at March 31, 2026. The Nomura Trust and Banking Co. (MUFG Bank Retiree Allowance Trust Account, 1.83%) is a trust account and is not listed. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' (¥147,858m); the J-GAAP statement shows no separate line for non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS: 'Purchase of treasury shares' ¥99,935m in fiscal 2026 (the line was reclassified out of 'Other, net' this year). STOCK COMP is null: Nintendo grants restricted stock only to Directors and reports only their compensation amounts; no company-wide share-based payment expense is disclosed. GEOGRAPHY: The Americas includes the U.S. (¥790,108m), which is not listed as a separate segment to avoid double counting.
